remarks: Bright, Spacious, Updated & Ready For Family ~ Come explore the possibilities in this 4 bedroom, 2.5 bath townhome in the heart of Springdale Village! You'll delight in the quality of this sunny space which features a pretty white kitchen with stone countertops, open living dining area, private deck overlooking nature, 3 generous bedrooms chic newer flooring and a large walk-out lower level with full bath - this flexible room caters to a variety of needs: 4th Bedroom (legal), family room, man-cave, exercise room, home office - you decide! Ideally located in the sought after Spring Hill Terrace Association, a well-maintained, pet-friendly Community with popular amenities including a pool, playground and guest parking. Enjoy life in the Village of Springdale, walking distance to Metro North train station, popular neighborhood restaurants, shops, the library and Springdale Elementary School!
